sources.title: Government of Andorra: passports
sources.publisher: Government of Andorra, Ministry of Justice and Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government passport page says the passport proves the holder's Andorran identity and nationality, provides the regulation for ordinary passports, and separately identifies the diplomatic-passport regulation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: El passaport ... acredita la identitat i la nacionalitat andorrana ... Reglament relatiu al passaport ordinari.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina FIPA: visa information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current visitor guidance is published by a state institution on the Council of Ministers' gov.ba domain. Its general citizenship list names Andorra, separately from later ordinary-, diplomatic-, official- and business-passport lists.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the following countries do not require a visa ... 2) Andorra.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina Service for Foreigners' Affairs: stay of aliens
sources.publisher: Service for Foreigners' Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The competent Service's current guidance states that the Decision on Visas controls the visa-free list and gives the statutory general limit for visa-free stays.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free aliens may enter and stay up to 90 days over a six-month period.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries, provides electronic delivery of the visa certificate, and lists a payable Andorra visa fee in Appendix I.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A ... Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email ... Andorra $68.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says visitors can obtain visas online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility, regular-passport and delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English translation asset says all nationalities can apply, limits the process to a regular passport, and sends eVisas by email with PDF download.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply ... only travel document ... regular passport ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

policies.title: Andorran ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance names Andorra in its general visa-free citizenship rule and states the general visa-free stay limit.
conditions: Use an Andorran ordinary passport. The current BiH government guidance lists Andorra among citizens who do not require a visa; separate document-specific lists do not limit that general rule.
The general visa-free stay is up to 90 days in a six-month period. Purpose, passport validity, funds, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

policies.title: Andorran ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use an Andorran ordinary passport. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.
Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and visa-waiver partners; Appendix I assigns Andorra a payable visa fee, resolving that exception for this passport.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Andorran ordinary passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present it for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Andorran ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the Andorran ordinary passport used for travel; the live service excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not a visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier and final-admission requirements remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register using the Andorran ordinary passport for travel.
Pay and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record for final immigration processing.
